tracklist: I Don't Wanna Hurt You Baby (Acoustic)
I Don't Wanna Hurt You Baby

rationale: Discography populator: full tracklist (7 tracks) per https://conandaily.com/2010/12/06/charlie-puths-ep-the-otto-tunes-james-l-brooks-how-do-you-know-film-released/, https://gigsty.com/artist/charlie-puth/album/the-otto-tunes-187ef0. Debut EP, independently released December 10, 2010. All sources agree on the same 7-track order. One outlier source lists 'I Don't Think About You' as track 7; the majority (4 sources) agree on 'I Don't Wanna Hurt You Baby'. Duplicate entry 'The Otto Tunes (2010)' is the same EP — recommend merge/delete.
